notes: RIMEA labels the season '2026/27' and its All-State page was updated 6/8/26; the calendar was updated 7/9/26. All-State choral auditions for both the Junior Division (grades 7-9) and Senior Division (grades 10-12) are held on a single day, Saturday November 14, 2026 at Ponaganset HS, with a registration deadline of Friday October 9, 2026. RIMEA fields four audition-based All-State choruses (Junior Mixed, Junior Treble, Senior Mixed, Senior Treble) plus a separate Elementary All-State Chorus entered by nomination. Junior and Senior Vocal audition practice MP3s were still marked PENDING at retrieval time. Concert performance repertoire and conductors for 2026/27 were not published on the pages read.

organization.name: Rhode Island Music Education Association
organization.description: RIMEA is a federated state association of the National Association for Music Education, located at 667 Waterman Avenue, East Providence, RI 02914. It runs the All-State festival, Solo & Ensemble, Large Ensemble Festivals and the Invitational Honors Festival. RIMEA states that the All-State Festival and audition process is not a right but a privilege reserved for students of RIMEA members and subject to RIMEA rules and regulations.

requirements.title: Grades 10-12
requirements.description: Senior Division vocal auditions are open to all students in school grades 10-12.

requirements.title: Must be a member in good standing of the school choir
requirements.description: If a student is not a member in good standing of his/her school performing ensemble, for any reason, he/she is not eligible to audition and perform in that All-State ensemble. Choir for choir. RIMEA does not recognize 'good' or 'bad' reasons; the rule is absolute and can only be changed by a majority vote of the RIMEA executive board. If a school does not offer the ensemble, RIMEA does not deny those students the opportunity to audition. Home-schooled students may participate if they choose to be a member of a school chorus (policy in effect since 2005/2006).

requirements.title: Sponsor registration
requirements.description: Sponsors (RIMEA member directors) must register students online at www.rimea.org/allstate.

requirements.title: Three-part audition
requirements.description: The audition has three parts: (1) audition piece — students sing their own voice part of the assigned selection; (2) scale; (3) sight singing.

requirements.title: Major scale by voice part
requirements.description: Students sing an ascending/descending major scale in quarter notes at quarter note = 72 in the assigned key for their voice part on the vowel 'ah'. Repeat the top note before descending; breathe whenever necessary. Starting pitch will be given. Soprano — key of G; Alto — key of D; Tenor — key of F; Bass — key of B-flat.

requirements.title: Sight singing
requirements.description: Students sight read an eight-measure phrase in 3/4 or 4/4 time consisting of dotted rhythms and leaps of thirds, fifths and octaves. Students may use solfege or a neutral syllable of their choice.

requirements.title: Practice MP3s / sing-along track at the audition
requirements.description: MP3 practice tracks with actual voices of the selected piece are posted at rimea.org/allstate. At the audition, students sing along with a track containing all other voices except their own part.

repertoire.title: Domine ad adjuvandum me festina
repertoire.notes: 2026-2027 Senior Division vocal audition piece. Latin text. Measures 73-120 only. Score sourced from CPDL (Choral Public Domain Library).

fees.description: $25.77 per student, per audition; non-refundable. Discounted to $25.00 (3%) if paid by cash or check.

All-State participation fee, non-refundable. Discounted to $90.00 if paid by cash or check. If a student performs in two or three ensembles, the additional fees are reduced to $41.24. Financial assistance for the participation fee is available based on financial need and available funds; sponsors may request it during audition registration.

requirements.title: Grades 7-9
requirements.description: Junior Division vocal auditions are open to all students in school grades 7-9.

requirements.title: Three-part audition
requirements.description: The audition has three parts: (1) audition piece — students sing their own voice part; (2) pitch matching; (3) sight singing.

requirements.title: Pitch matching
requirements.description: Students listen to a four quarter-note pattern played and repeat it back on a neutral syllable. Ranges used: bass C3-A3; tenor G3-E4; alto B3-A4; soprano E4-E5.

requirements.title: Sight singing
requirements.description: Students sight read a four-measure phrase in 4/4 time consisting of quarter and half notes in stepwise motion. Students may use solfege or a neutral syllable of their choice.

requirements.title: Practice MP3s / sing-along track at the audition
requirements.description: MP3 practice tracks with actual voices of the selected piece are posted at rimea.org/allstate; at the audition students sing along with a track containing all voices except their own.

repertoire.notes: 2026-2027 Junior Division vocal audition piece. Measures 23-56 only.
